stanza: Did an angel whisper in your ear?
And hold you close, and take away your fear?
In those long, last moments

moments.line: Yeah, we're taking in these moments
stanza: Walking for the finish line
Is all I'm really doing
In between these friends of mine
Yeah, we're taking in these moments
Now after the ground has opened up
Now after you died
I wonder what could beacon me forward into the rest of life
I can glimpse occasional moments
Gleaming like bonfires burning from across the fjord

moments.line: All these places had their moments
stanza: All these places had their moments
With lovers and friends, I still can recall
Some are dead and some are living
In my life, I've loved them all

moments.linePrev: In order to justify most spurious desires

moments.songTitle: Any Moment / Moments in the Woods
stanza: Any moment, big or small
Is a moment, after all
Seize the moment, skies may fall
Any moment
Days are made of moments
All are worth exploring
Many kinds of moments
None is worth ignoring
All we have are moments
Memories for storing
One would be so boring

moments.line: But I guess I'll have to settle for a few brief moments
stanza: Lately I've been wishing I had one desire
Something that would make me never want another
Something that would make it so that nothing mattered
All would be clear then
But I guess I'll have to settle for a few brief moments
And watch it all dissolve into a single second
And try to write it down into a perfect sonnet
Or one foolish line

moments.line: Here to relive your darkest moments
stanza: Regrets collect like old friends
Here to relive your darkest moments
I can see no way, I can see no way
And all of the ghouls come out to play
And every demon wants his pound of flesh
But I like to keep some things to myself
I'd like to keep my issues drawn
It's always darkest before the dawn
